values.Description:
Welcome Baby Decoration Kit (57 Pieces) - Baby Shower Set

This 57 piece Welcome Baby Decoration Kit is made for baby showers and newborn welcome celebrations, with a balloon arrangement in dark blue, pastel blue and white plus silver confetti balloons and silver foil decorations. It brings the main decoration pieces and setup accessories together for a coordinated wall display centred around the printed Welcome Baby foil.

The finished arrangement can be created as a balloon arch around the display, with the silver moon foil and star foils placed around the balloon decoration. Use it for room decoration at home, in a hotel room, banquet hall or party venue when you want a dedicated baby shower display and a clear area for photographs. The combination of balloons and foil pieces also works as a baby shower photo backdrop for family pictures and welcome baby photos.

WHAT YOU GET (57 Pieces)

15 Dark Blue Balloons

15 Pastel Blue Balloons

15 White Balloons

4 Silver Confetti Balloons

1 Silver Moon Foil

3 Silver Star Foils

1 Welcome Baby Foil

1 Pump

1 Arch Tape

1 Glue Dot Roll

KEY FEATURES

57 Pieces - Provides the listed balloons, foil decorations and setup accessories together in one decoration kit

49 Balloons - Includes dark blue, pastel blue and white balloons along with silver confetti balloons for the main arrangement

Three Balloon Colours - Lets you create a coordinated balloon display using dark blue, pastel blue and white balloons

Silver Foil Decorations - Adds one moon foil and three star foils around the balloon arrangement for the finished backdrop

Welcome Baby Foil - Places the printed Welcome Baby wording at the centre of the decoration for a clear celebration message

Arch Tape and Glue Dot Roll - Helps arrange the balloon display and attach suitable decoration pieces to the selected wall or backdrop area

Included Pump - Helps inflate the balloons before arranging the display, so the listed setup accessories are available with the decoration pieces

PERFECT FOR

Baby Shower

Newborn Welcome Celebration

Baby Shower Room Decoration

Home Party

Hotel Room Decoration

Banquet Hall Decoration

Baby Shower Photo Backdrop

Welcome Baby Party Decor

Family Baby Shower Photos

Home Welcome Baby Decoration

WHY CHOOSE THIS KIT

The kit keeps the decoration components together so the buyer can plan one matching display instead of separately arranging the main balloon colours, silver foil shapes, printed Welcome Baby message and basic setup accessories. The photo arrangement shows how the dark blue, pastel blue and white balloons can frame the central message while the silver moon and star foils add separate foil shapes around the display.

The four silver confetti balloons can be mixed into the main balloon arrangement for a different visual finish from the plain balloons. The Welcome Baby foil provides the printed wording, while the moon and star foils can be positioned where they suit the available wall space. The exact placement is flexible because the included arch tape and glue dot roll are used during installation.

The kit can be used for a home baby shower, a hotel room baby shower, a banquet hall setup or another party venue with a suitable wall or backdrop area. It is also suitable when the main purpose is a baby shower photo backdrop, family photographs or a welcome baby display.

HOW TO SET UP

Inflate the dark blue, pastel blue, white and silver confetti balloons with the included pump.

Use the arch tape to arrange the inflated balloons into the desired curved balloon display and position it on the selected wall or backdrop area.

Use the glue dot roll to attach suitable foil pieces and arrange the Welcome Baby foil, silver moon foil and silver star foils around the balloon display.

Plan the placement of the moon and star foils so the printed Welcome Baby message remains easy to see in photographs.

Start by inflating the balloons and preparing the arch tape for the balloon arrangement.
